messages:
incident-bot: ALARM -> Dedicated pool atlasx-vpc-prod (pool-id: pool-ax-03) GPU util=99%, queue_time_avg=125s, 503_rate rising. Severity=P1. Paging #eng-oncall #eng-sre #platform-ops.
amy: oncall amy here, ACK. Pulling logs and dashboards now. Linking alert: https://grafana/redwood/d/pool-ax-03
josh: looking at traces — this looks like a single tenant (atlasx) dominating. Long-lived streaming sessions with batch_size=64 from their batcher. Several tasks pinned 4 GPUs each.
lee: autoscale for this pool is currently disabled for reserved tenants (policy: reserved_fixed). We do have burst capacity in us-west (burst-pool-7) but requires billing approval / manual trigger.
marta: pinging AtlasX CS contact (sarah@atlasx.com). They've opened tickets complaining about 503s and timeouts in EU and US.
nina: early mitigation option: evict non-critical jobs for tenant atlasx (labels: background,test). Dry-run command: `./tools/drain-tenant.sh --tenant atlasx --selectors background,test --dry-run`.
rahul: runtime suggestion: fall back heavy routes to a quantized 13B variant (13b-q4) to reduce memory pressure. Tradeoff: slightly lower quality/latency change but reduces GPU mem footprint.
amy: quick decision loop: Path A (preferred): request burst->provision +4 GPUs from burst-pool-7 AND evict background jobs. Path B (fallback if billing not approved in 5m): start model fallback + soft rate-limit heavy endpoints.
lee: requesting burst approval from billing now (cc billing@redwood). Creating incident Jira: INC-AX-241 (https://jira/redwood/browse/INC-AX-241).
marta: just spoke to Sarah at AtlasX — they'll approve temporary burst for immediate mitigation if we notify about cost. Asking for 30m window.
josh: executing eviction commands now. Running:
```
kubectl label jobs -l tenant=atlasx,priority!=high eviction=now
./orchestrator/evict --tenant atlasx --selectors priority!=high --min-safety=2
```
nina: eviction completed on 4 nodes, reclaimed ~3 GPUs. Queue_time avg dropped from 125s -> 42s. 503 rate down ~70%.
rahul: starting progressive routing change for heavy streaming endpoint: push routing rule alias `atlasx-stream` -> `model:13b-q4` with 25% rollout. Command: `redwood route update --tenant atlasx --route /chat/stream --variant 13b-q4 --pct 25`.
oliver: taking secondary on-call for next 30m, handoff done. Monitoring dashboard pinned. Escalation list updated in INC-AX-241.
marta: AtlasX confirms improvements on their side (response times 200 TPS restored for core endpoints). They want cost breakdown + postmortem.
amy: summary & next steps: incident mitigated via eviction + temporary burst (billing approved), partial model fallback for remaining load. Actions: 1) Postmortem (assign INC-AX-241) 2) Runbook update to allow emergency autoscale for reserved tenants 3) Recommend tenant-level rate-limits / max-batch enforcement 4) Cost reconciliation with AtlasX.
incident-bot: STATUS -> mitigated. Incident state: DEGRADED -> MITIGATED. Closing notifications sent. INC-AX-241 -> postmortem assigned to amy and josh.
